record.paper_title: Harvesting and stocking in discrete-time contest competition models with open problems and conjectures
record.original_question: For the normalized delayed Pielou harvesting equation x_{n+1} = b x_n/(1 + x_{n-1}) - h with b > 1, let D_h be the largest set of initial conditions whose solutions persist under harvesting quota h. When 0 < h < 1, prove or disprove that the persistent set at quota 1 is contained in the persistent set at quota h, that is, D_1 is a subset of D_h.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the normalized delayed Pielou difference equation with constant-yield harvesting
  x_{n+1} = b x_n / (1 + x_{n-1}) - h,    n = 0, 1, 2, ...,
where b > 1 is a fixed parameter and h ≥ 0 is a harvesting quota. A solution {x_n} with initial conditions (x_{-1}, x_0) ∈ (0, ∞)^2 is said to persist if x_n is defined and remains in (0, ∞) for every n ≥ 0. For each h ≥ 0 let
  D_h = {(x_{-1}, x_0) ∈ (0, ∞)^2 : the solution of the equation with quota h persists}
be the persistent set at quota h. Prove or disprove the following statement: for every b > 1 and every h with 0 < h < 1, one has the inclusion
  D_1 ⊆ D_h.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returns work on the delayed Pielou equation with constant-yield harvesting that characterizes persistent sets (e.g., via a Lyness-type 8-periodic invariant region at h = 1), but no source was found that establishes or refutes the inclusion D_1 ⊆ D_h for 0 < h < 1. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The dynamics of some discrete models with delay under the effect of constant yield harvesting
status_evidence.snippet: Studies stability, boundedness and persistence of delayed discrete harvested models including Pielou-type equations.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on persistence exist, but no proof or disproof of the inclusion D_1 ⊆ D_h is reported.
